name: jannat-enterprise-website
description: Production website for JANNAT ENTERPRISE - Digital Service & Technology Centre, Domkal. Optimized for Cloudflare Pages.

scripts.start: node -e "const http=require('http'), fs=require('fs'), path=require('path'); http.createServer((req,res)=>{ let p = path.join(__dirname, 'dist', req.url === '/' ? 'index.html' : req.url.split('?')[0]); if(!fs.existsSync(p)) p = path.join(__dirname, 'dist', 'index.html'); const ext = path.extname(p); const mime = { '.html': 'text/html', '.css': 'text/css', '.js': 'text/javascript', '.svg': 'image/svg+xml', '.png': 'image/png', '.json': 'application/json' }[ext] || 'application/octet-stream'; res.writeHead(200, {'Content-Type': mime}); fs.createReadStream(p).pipe(res); }).listen(8080, ()=>console.log('Serving dist at http://localhost:8080'));"

author: JANNAT ENTERPRISE
